mapper.select: SELECT batch_job_id AS batchJobId, openai_batch_id AS openaiBatchId, input_file_id AS inputFileId, output_file_id AS outputFileId, error_file_id AS errorFileId, status, target, query_text AS queryText, embedding_model AS embeddingModel, vector_store AS vectorStore, input_file_path AS inputFilePath, output_file_path AS outputFilePath, requested_count AS requestedCount, submitted_count AS submittedCount, completed_count AS completedCount, failed_count AS failedCount, ingested_count AS ingestedCount, last_error_message AS lastErrorMessage FROM semantic_batch_jobs WHERE openai_batch_id = #{openaiBatchId}

SELECT batch_job_id AS batchJobId, openai_batch_id AS openaiBatchId, input_file_id AS inputFileId, output_file_id AS outputFileId, error_file_id AS errorFileId, status, target, query_text AS queryText, embedding_model AS embeddingModel, vector_store AS vectorStore, input_file_path AS inputFilePath, output_file_path AS outputFilePath, requested_count AS requestedCount, submitted_count AS submittedCount, completed_count AS completedCount, failed_count AS failedCount, ingested_count AS ingestedCount, last_error_message AS lastErrorMessage FROM semantic_batch_jobs ORDER BY batch_job_id

SELECT batch_job_id AS batchJobId, openai_batch_id AS openaiBatchId, input_file_id AS inputFileId, output_file_id AS outputFileId, error_file_id AS errorFileId, status, target, query_text AS queryText, embedding_model AS embeddingModel, vector_store AS vectorStore, input_file_path AS inputFilePath, output_file_path AS outputFilePath, requested_count AS requestedCount, submitted_count AS submittedCount, completed_count AS completedCount, failed_count AS failedCount, ingested_count AS ingestedCount, last_error_message AS lastErrorMessage FROM semantic_batch_jobs WHERE status IN ('validating', 'in_progress', 'finalizing') OR (status = 'completed' AND ingested_count = 0) ORDER BY submitted_at
mapper.update: UPDATE semantic_batch_jobs SET status = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'completed' AND ingested_count > 0 THEN 'INGESTED' ELSE #{status} END, output_file_id = #{outputFileId}, error_file_id = #{errorFileId}, completed_count = #{completedCount}, failed_count = #{failedCount}, last_error_message = NULL, completed_at = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'completed' THEN COALESCE(completed_at, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ELSE completed_at END WHERE openai_batch_id = #{openaiBatchId}

UPDATE semantic_batch_jobs SET status = 'INGESTED', output_file_path = #{outputFilePath}, ingested_count = #{ingestedCount}, ingested_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, last_error_message = NULL WHERE openai_batch_id = #{openaiBatchId}
